This is the first library statement that consumes the fuzzer bytes into vulnerability-relevant parser state; the later axis-count, glyph-count, and gvar-table reads all come from this face closure.

The fix replaces this raw-reference path with blob-bounded `hb_bytes_t` slices from `blob->as_bytes().sub_array(((unsigned) dataZ) + start_offset, length)`, so an out-of-range glyph-var span collapses to empty bytes instead of being dereferenced.
